failures.title: Courier on a motorbike read as a pedestrian
failures.text: A delivery rider in the lane was tracked as a 'person' and flagged as jaywalking (model 177.2-180.4 s).

failures.title: Signal queue read as a stopped vehicle
failures.text: Cars waiting at red for 15-20 s were chained into a 'stopped vehicle'; this is why the class is no longer predicted.

failures.title: Tracker ID switch read as a U-turn
failures.text: The track jumped between different cars and finally onto a pedestrian, which looked like a U-turn (model 62.1-87.8 s).

failures.title: Moped on the zebra read as failure to yield
failures.text: A moped moving along the crossing with pedestrians is not a vehicle driving through it (model 25.9-40.6 s).

failures.title: Distant overlapping boxes read as a near miss
failures.text: Two cars far away in normal flow overlapped in the image; no braking or swerving (model 243.9-245.0 s).
